Question Choices: Each small square on the grid equals 1 square unit. If a rectangle covers 15 small squares, what is its area?
Hints: Count equal-size squares covering the surface without gaps or overlaps.
Solution: Fifteen one-square-unit tiles cover 15 square units.

Question Choices: Select. A rectangle has 4 rows of 6 unit squares. What is its area?: ~~10-square-units | 24-square-units | 20-square-units~~
Hints: Multiply the number of unit squares in each row by the number of rows.
Solution: Area counts the unit squares covering the surface. Multiply length by width: 4 x 6 = 24 square units.

Question Choices: Which rectangle has the same area as rectangle with 2 units by 6 units? (A) Rectangle with 3 units by 4 units (B) Rectangle with 5 units by 3 units (C) Rectangle with 7 units by 2 units : A B C
Hints: Compare products of the side lengths; different pairs can have the same product.
